_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 4 — bản phủ tiếng Anh, phần Tử vi của su_kien_kb.json (sao_cung_menh, sao_toa_menh). Phần quẻ (que_cau_truc, ten_tuong) làm ở GĐ 6.

source.tuvi_vi_tri_v1: Rules for placing the 14 main stars from the position of Zi Wei (Zi Wei Dou Shu Quan Shu) — computed deterministically, checked against 60 sample charts

sao_cung_menh.tieu_de: When {sao} is in the {cung}, which stars are in the Life Palace
sao_cung_menh.luon_co: When {sao} is in the {cung}, the Life Palace always holds {luon_co} (checked across all 12 positions of Zi Wei).
sao_cung_menh.khong_co: When {sao} is in the {cung}, the Life Palace does not hold one fixed star.
sao_cung_menh.vo_chinh_dieu: In {n} of the 12 positions the Life Palace has no main star at all — it is then read by borrowing the stars of the opposite palace.
cot: Main stars in the Life Palace

sao_toa_menh.tieu_de: When {sao} sits right in the Life Palace: which stars are in the Wealth, Career and Travel palaces
sao_toa_menh.doan: Across all 12 positions of the Zi Wei star: when {sao} sits right in the Life Palace, the three palaces read together with it — Wealth, Career and Travel (the trine and opposite palaces) — hold the stars in the table below; this is the framework that comes with {sao} on every chart with {sao} in the Life Palace.
